response.original_title: (Room!FAQs) How do I add a cabin to my Silversea Cruise?

Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, ☎ +1-866-259-1002 (US/Canada) or +44-120-420-8151 (UK) separate reservation.  To add, upgrade or modify an additional state room or room to 1-866-259-1002 an existing Silversea Cruise  reservation, you must book the new room as a separate reservation and call Silversea Cruise s Customer Support at 1-866-259-1002
